metadata.description: projio's portable Claude Code skills: they need git only, not projio. Versioned on their own: a release is a version bump, an export and a push.

plugins.name: projio-workflow
plugins.description: A standing manager session for any git project (incoming notes, session states, board, handoffs), its setup, a session wrap that commits by path and writes a handoff, the 'always complete, never finished' check, and analysis threads (where a thread stands and what to work on next; result notes and the thread's state doc). Needs git and Python 3.9+, not projio.
